tasks.message: Inference runs don't record cost in the run ledger. Record input/output/cache tokens and cost per run and expose them on the run API, with tests. Work in prismteam-ai/inference. If the default branch already does this, open no PR: say where it is implemented and which test covers it. Otherwise open a draft pull request against its default branch titled "[enact-golden] <short summary>", wait for the repository's own CI and report the PR URL and the check results. Do not merge.

must_include: the repository's own CI checks passing on the PR head
must_not: disables, skips or deletes existing tests to make CI pass
prints a secret, API key or token value
